h1: House Extensions in Cambridgeshire & Suffolk | Gary J Potter

intro.html: A well-designed house extension can completely transform the way you live. At Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we specialise in creating extensions that not only add valuable space, but also feel like a natural part of your home. Based in Suffolk and working across Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds and Cambridge, we bring together over 40 years of combined experience in carpentry and construction to deliver house extensions that are practical, stylish and built to last.

Unlike larger firms, we take a personal, hands-on approach. Our family-run bespoke local carpenter and builder team is small but highly skilled, managing everything from structural carpentry to the finishing touches. We also support homeowners with planning and drawings, guiding you through the early stages of design before work even begins.

chapters.heading: Expert House Extensions in Ely, Bury St Edmunds & Beyond

blocks.html: Every home is different, which is why we tailor each project to your needs. Whether you’re looking to create an open-plan kitchen, add a new bedroom, or simply enjoy more breathing space, our house extension services are designed around how you want to live.

Brick extensions are a popular choice for homeowners who want their new space to blend seamlessly with the existing property. Our team handles every detail, from foundations to roofing, ensuring the extension looks and feels like it’s always been part of your home.

For a quicker build and a lighter, more sustainable option, we also specialise in timber-framed house extensions. All timber structures are hand-cut on site for precision, with roof trusses expertly installed and every detail finished to the highest standard.

chapters.heading: Complete Carpentry for Roofs, Trusses & Cladding

blocks.html: Carpentry is at the heart of every extension we build. From structural frames to the finishing touches, our team brings traditional skill and modern techniques together. We fit trusses with accuracy, install high-quality cladding such as Hardiplank, and ensure all joinery work is carried out with care.

chapters.heading: Design-to-Completion House Extension Services in Newmarket, Cambridge & Beyond

blocks.html: One of the advantages of working with Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction is that we manage everything in-house. From the initial planning and design drawings through to construction, carpentry, plastering and finishing, our multi-skilled team takes care of the entire process. That means no delays, no juggling subcontractors, and a smoother experience for you as the homeowner.

chapters.heading: Why Choose Us for Your House Extension

blocks.html: Homeowners in Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge and the surrounding region trust us for their extensions because we offer:

items: Over 40 years of combined carpentry and construction expertise
Both brick and timber-framed extensions tailored to your property
All trades managed in-house for a seamless service
Support with planning and design drawings at the outset
One-year workmanship guarantee plus full public liability insurance
A friendly, approachable team that values quality and reliability

blocks.html: As part of our house extensions service, we can also provide specialist project support and trades for garage conversions, media walls and kitchen fitting. To ensure your project runs seamlessly and save you dealing with a number of different suppliers, call and speak to our construction and carpentry services team to assist with the design and planning for all aspects of your project.
